description: Metadata API retrieve/deploy via sf CLI and package.xml: manifest authoring, destructiveChanges, deploy options (checkOnly, testLevel, rollbackOnError), CI scripting. NOT for what package.xml can hold or deploy-order concepts — use apex/metadata-api-and-package-xml. NOT for a delete that fails on a still-referenced component — use devops/destructive-changes-deployment.
name: metadata-api-retrieve-deploy
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — Metadata Types Reference:
Salesforce CLI Reference — `sf project retrieve` / `sf project deploy`:

Metadata API Developer Guide, Summer '26 PDF (api_meta.txt): `testLevel` values and defaults L4278–4321; `rollbackOnError` defaults to true and must be true for production L3329–3333; deletions before additions by default, Pre/Post manifests from API 33.0 L4648–4660; quick deploy needs validation within the last 10 days L3454. Supports Gotchas 4, 6, 7 and the Core Concepts tables.

Metadata API Developer Guide, deploy() `DeployOptions` and Deleting Components (api_meta.txt L4160–4167 allowMissingFiles/autoUpdatePackage not for production; L4170–4176 checkOnly; L4234–4241 purgeOnDelete sandbox/DE only; L4255–4261 SOAP `rollbackOnError` "The default is false", contrasting with REST L3329; L4614–4631 destructive manifest format, no wildcards, sibling package.xml with version; L4664–4691 Post-destructive sample, deletions before tests, version taken from package.xml) and Salesforce DX Developer Guide (sfdx_dev.txt L14211–14213 retrieve by manifest, L14258–14269 validate then quick deploy, L13523 `--ignore-errors` not for production, L2809–2825 `--metadata-dir` and `project convert source`). Supports references/retrieve-deploy-runbook.md and the checker.

Metadata API Developer Guide, InstalledPackage (api_meta.txt L81389–81397) — 1GP install/uninstall type that must be alone in a deploy manifest; unlocked and 2GP use `sf package install`. ExternalCredential available from API 56.0 (L63618). Supports Gotchas 1 and 2.
outputs: sf CLI retrieve and deploy commands
